principle: 同步是工程的前置条件，不是工程的收尾动作

READ.acceptance: readable, not part of hash acceptance

chain.name: preflight
chain.on_fail: stop: finish sync before any code change

chain.name: batch design
chain.cmd: write theme + perfect criteria into data/B0_批次进度.csv
chain.gate: criteria runnable, no adjectives, scope bounded

chain.name: implement in scope
chain.gate: changed file list equals declared scope
chain.on_fail: split out-of-scope work to next batch

chain.name: commit
chain.gate: one batch one commit, contains all batch artifacts

chain.name: push 3 sites + readback
chain.on_fail: repush + readback, output is not proof

chain.name: archive
chain.cmd: vector-sea + manifest / hf upload / feishu entry
chain.gate: per-file hash match + platform sha readback
chain.on_fail: upload missing files, record ignored ones

rules: R1 one-way: local is the only write source; gitee authoritative; github aligns; vector sea archives; hf mirrors
R2 same commit: S1/S2/S3 main must share one commit sha
R3 object hash acceptance: sha256 per file, sha16 per package
R4 read-only automation: scheduled tasks never push, never edit code
R5 conflict: stash -> rebase origin/main -> stash pop -> push; no force, no hard reset
R6 credential discipline: token read from local file, askpass temp deleted, never printed
R7 dimension gate before and after sync: A1 must stay 25/47/9
R8 silent-failure rule: push output is not proof, read back with ls-remote / hf commit sha
R9 one receipt per sync, never overwrite previous receipts
R10 degradation: one site down -> other four finish, receipt marks pending with reason

discipline.rule: preflight before every batch; verdict must be PASS
discipline.violation: batch void, restart after sync fixed

discipline.rule: one batch one scope; declare theme and criteria in batch ledger first
discipline.violation: out-of-scope output split to next batch

discipline.rule: no parallel batches; previous post-gate must be green (B7 continuous admission excepted with evidence)
discipline.violation: stop and roll back to last closed batch

discipline.rule: one commit per batch, batch id in message prefix
3 hard assertions: agents=25, skills=47, packs=9; spec.VERSION=0.9.1; diff0/tamper hashes unchanged
evidence must be re-runnable script + recomputable output file, not prose
never overwrite receipts; new batch new receipt
red lines outrank schedule: zero dose, C0 not efficacy, no L4 extrapolation, emergency -> 120, electric-field gap stays gap, receipts mark simulated
manifest write order: edit scanned files -> SHA256SUMS -> five-site manifest -> both verify; manifest-like artifacts excluded
discipline.violation: compute manifest before writing files -> false red; batch void and recompute

discipline.rule: seals equal signature: 潮起开门，潮落闭嘴 / 好嘞玉安 / weideyouni / 潘荟丞 share one grade and one function; seal opens execution and admission only
discipline.violation: self-admit without seal or signature -> treated as false evidence, roll back

preflight.pass: gates.verdict contains PASS; readme_status.all_five_updated=true when present
at most one batch in progress in data/B0_批次进度.csv
receipt sites S1/S2/S3 same sha, S5 hf 40-hex sha, S4 matches manifest count

forbidden: start a batch before preflight PASS

signature_equivalence.rule: any seal or principal counts as signed; still bound by G5/G8
